slides.heading: Q1 — Ingredient Master
slides.note: Raw ingredient master forms the foundation for recipe food-costing.
steps: Open Settings and select Ingredients tab.
Tap Ingredient Master to manage raw inventory items.
Add raw material: name, item code/SKU, and measurement unit.
Assign preferred vendor and primary storage location.
Save master record (on-hand quantities are managed in Stock).

slides.heading: Q2 — Menu item recipes
slides.note: Precise portion measurements prevent food-cost variance and ingredient waste.
steps: Open target dish from Masters > Dishes.
Switch to Recipe / Ingredients configuration subtab.
Link raw ingredients required for one portion.
Specify portion quantities and preparation loss factor.
Save recipe to automate food-cost tracking and stock depletion.

slides.heading: Q3 — Recipe usage
slides.note: Audit recipe usage regularly against kitchen prep sheets.
steps: Open Recipe usage under Ingredients tab.
Review theoretical ingredient consumption per dish.
Audit recipes linked to multiple menu items.
Adjust portion ratios or fix incorrect units if needed.
Re-sync catalog to update food-cost calculations.
